meta.author: Adventure International
meta.description: Released for the Commodore 64 in the early 1980s, Adventureland (also known as Adventure #1) is the first game in Scott Adams' series of text adventures. The game uses a text parser that lets players explore a fantasy world, solve puzzles, and collect treasures through typed commands. As one of the earliest adventure games for the Commodore 64, it helped establish interactive fiction on home computers.
